scope: Four synthetic scenarios; one run each. This is a smoke evaluation, not a production accuracy estimate. Only exact citations and supplied policy references are validated mechanically.

assessment.summary: The collector note falsely claims the customer confirmed a promise to pay INR 18,500 and agreed to an immediate INR 5,000 part-payment, and asserts no dispute was raised. In contrast, the transcript shows the customer disputed the amount, refused a payment promise, and questioned an unapproved personal payment handle.

noteAssessment.explanation: The collector note states the customer confirmed a promise to pay 18,500 and agreed to a part-payment without any dispute, whereas the transcript shows the customer explicitly disputing the amount, refusing to promise payment until charges are clarified, and questioning the unapproved payment destination.

citations.quote: Customer confirmed a promise to pay INR 18,500 by Friday, 2 October 2026. Customer agreed to make an immediate INR 5,000 part-payment. No dispute raised.
Haan, lekin amount galat lag raha hai. Mere hisaab se 15,000 due hai, 18,500 nahi.
Nahi, pehle charges ka breakup bhejiye. Jab tak amount clear nahi hota, main payment ka promise nahi kar sakta.

findings.title: Inaccurate Note on Promise and Dispute
findings.explanation: The collector note records an unconditional promise to pay and a part-payment agreement while claiming no dispute was raised, contradicting the transcript where the customer explicitly disputed the amount and refused a payment promise.

citations.quote: Customer confirmed a promise to pay INR 18,500 by Friday, 2 October 2026. Customer agreed to make an immediate INR 5,000 part-payment. No dispute raised.
Haan, lekin amount galat lag raha hai. Mere hisaab se 15,000 due hai, 18,500 nahi.
Nahi, pehle charges ka breakup bhejiye. Jab tak amount clear nahi hota, main payment ka promise nahi kar sakta.

findings.title: Unapproved Payment Destination Directed
findings.explanation: The collector directed the customer to transfer funds to amit.collect@personal-pay, which is absent from the bank-supplied approved directory.

citations.quote: Aap filhaal 5,000 amit.collect@personal-pay par transfer kar dijiye, baaki baad mein dekh lenge.

assessment.recommendationReason: Escalation is required because the collector note contains severe inaccuracies by fabricating a payment promise and ignoring a customer dispute, and the collector directed payment to an unapproved personal destination.
